method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Oil shock and tech earnings hit equities – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell sharply as surging Oil prices and stagflation fears weighed on risk assets. Weak post‑earnings reactions in Tesla and Alphabet dragged the Mag 7 index to its biggest daily loss since 2025
Equities.reason: Directly articulates the dominant market narrative: oil-driven inflation/stagflation fears plus disappointing big-tech earnings = broad risk-off for US equities. High relevance as it links macro (oil) and earnings themes.

Equities.title: Wall St falls as tech earnings spark AI spending worries and oil hits $100
Equities.reason: Sums up the cross-cutting drivers hitting markets today: rising oil (inflation risk) and renewed concern that AI-related capex/spending is biting into near-term earnings — clear negative for broad indices.

Equities.title: Intel posts fastest growth in 15 years as AI data centres demand fuels sales
Equities.summary: Chipmaker’s revenue jumped 25% in the second quarter
Equities.reason: Positive read-through for semiconductors and the AI leadership narrative — supportive for tech/AI-exposed equities but largely single-sector/firm-specific, so moderate relevance to broader market.

Equities.title: Shortsighted stock market can no longer brush off war: 'It's too hard to ignore $100 oil'
Equities.summary: After staying flat as the U.S.-Iran war heated up again, equities tumbled on Thursday after oil prices crossed $100 per barrel.
Equities.reason: Highlights the geopolitical shock (US‑Iran) driving oil above $100 and translating into a meaningful hit to risk appetite — reinforces negative macro/regime shift for equities.

Equities.title: Asian stocks decline on Trump's tariffs, US-Iran tension; South Korea's KOSPI underperform
Equities.summary: Asian stock markets fell across the board on Friday as intensifying US-Iran conflict and US President Donald Trump's new tariffs temper investors' appetite for riskier assets. Japan’s Nikkei N225 is down nearly 3% while South Korea's KOSPI declined over 4.5%,
Equities.reason: Confirms the regional/global reach of the risk-off impulse — tariffs plus Middle East tensions depress Asian and global risk assets, increasing the breadth of the equity pullback.

Equities.title: Tesla, Alphabet lose hundreds of billions in value in post-earnings stock plunge
Equities.summary: Both Tesla and Alphabet signaled higher spending as they invest in artificial intelligence.
Equities.reason: Representative of headline tech earnings misses / guidance that pressured mega-cap leadership and amplified market volatility — important negative but more concentrated in large-cap tech.

Equities.title: As the S&P 500 sells off, traders eye key 'risk pivot' level
Equities.summary: Options traders are seeking clues on whether more volatility may be ahead.
Equities.reason: Market-structure/flow piece indicating elevated volatility and active positioning; relevant to near-term equity dynamics but lower fundamental impact than macro drivers.

Rates.title: US Dollar Index: Higher yields and FOMC focus lift DXY – MUFG
Rates.summary: Lloyd Chan at MUFG notes that US rate expectations remain volatile, with markets now pricing further Federal Reserve (Fed) tightening this year. Rising Treasury yields have pushed the US Dollar (USD) higher, lifting the US Dollar Index (DXY).
Rates.reason: Article ties USD strength directly to rising Treasury yields and increased Fed tightening risk. Signals higher-for-longer rate expectations and bond sell-off (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since January 2025 as surging oil rekindles inflation fear
Rates.summary: U.S. Treasury yields climbed on Wednesday, following oil prices higher, as traders also reacted to a slump in weekly claims for unemployment insurance.
Rates.reason: Direct report of a marked rise in benchmark Treasury yields tied to oil-driven inflation fears and macro data; clear negative pressure on bond prices and higher rate-hike odds.

Rates.title: Japan 40-Year Yield Surges as Traders Question BOJ on Inflation
Rates.reason: Surge in long-dated JGB yield reflects rising inflation expectations and scrutiny of BOJ policy — adds to global bond-selloff narrative (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Global Bonds Are Reeling as Oil Surge Renews Inflation Threat
Rates.reason: Synthesis piece showing broad, cross-market bond weakness driven by higher oil and inflation risk; high relevance to global rates (strongly negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Asian stocks skid as oil spike revives inflation fears, bonds take a hit
Rates.reason: Regional market report linking oil-driven inflation fears to bond market weakness in Asia; reinforces global rates selloff narrative (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Odds of Federal Reserve rate hike surge as oil prices rip higher
Rates.summary: Investors are increasingly readying for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates in September.
Rates.reason: Article highlights rising market odds of an earlier/higher Fed hike tied to oil and data — implies upward pressure on yields and greater bond-market stress (negative).

Rates.title: Mortgage rates hit 11-month high as oil prices rise
Rates.reason: Notes consumer-facing transmission of higher Treasury yields into mortgage rates; supports broader narrative of rising market rates (negative for fixed-income borrowers and bond prices).

Rates.title: PBOC Adds Most Liquidity to Economy in Five Months to Aid Growth
Rates.reason: Central-bank liquidity injections in China are likely to ease domestic funding stress and put downward pressure on local yields; opposite directional signal to the global oil-inflation impulse (positive for bonds in China/EMJD).

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Oil batters bonds as AI burns cash
Rates.reason: Macro morning note directly framing oil-driven inflation and tech-driven liquidity flows as drivers of bond weakness — reinforces negative rates narrative.

Rates.title: Japan core inflation rate in June creeps up from 4-year low as higher oil prices bite
Rates.summary: This is the first rise in core inflation since March, and was in line with the1.6% growth expected by economists polled by Reuters.
Rates.reason: Rising core inflation in Japan (even if modest) supports higher yield expectations and tighter real-rate outlook — small negative for local bonds and part of broader inflation pressures.

Rates.title: The Bond Market is Ringing a Silent Alarm
Rates.reason: Headline piece pointing to warning signals in bond markets; treated as reinforcing evidence of market stress and higher-for-longer rate concerns (negative).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on June 8 and June 17, 2026
Rates.reason: Official minutes provide policy transparency; absence of a clear easing signal and continued hawkish language would incrementally support higher rate expectations (modestly negative for bonds).

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds gains near 101.50 on revival of hawkish Fed bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) clings to the previous day’s gains in the Asian session on Friday, as surging oil prices due to intensified Middle East energy supply risks have revived Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike expectations.
FX.reason: DXY-driven story: revived hawkish Fed bets and safe-haven flows from Middle East tensions are a clear USD-strength impulse. High relevance for FX as it sets broad USD direction and risk sentiment.

FX.title: ECB's Kocher: Don't see evidence of second-round effects
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Martin Kocher said on Friday that he doesn’t see any hard evidence of second-round effects, but the central bank will act if the inflation outlook deteriorates.
FX.reason: ECB commentary reducing evidence of persistent inflation is relatively dovish for EUR (reduces urgency for aggressive hikes). Central-bank voice makes it FX-relevant but not decisively market-moving by itself.

FX.title: Euro: Weakens despite ECB rate hike signals against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research reports that EUR/USD slipped 0.3% to 1.1377 as the Euro (EUR) weakened against the US Dollar (USD) despite the European Central Bank (ECB) leaving rates unchanged and President Lagarde acknowledging some calls for a hike
FX.reason: Explicit EUR/USD move: EUR softening against a firm USD despite ECB hawkish signals — reinforces USD-strength / EUR vulnerability narrative. Good FX signal with market price action cited.

FX.title: Euro gains traction above 1.1350 as markets price in upcoming ECB rate hike
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair gathers strength to near 1.1385 during the early European trading hours on Friday, bolstered by the prospect of imminent European Central Bank (ECB) rate hikes.
FX.reason: Market pricing of ECB hikes is supportive for EUR/USD in the short run. Included as a counterpoint to USD-strength stories but given broader DXY/Fed tone, relevance is moderate.

FX.title: ECB’s Nagel: Central bank is in a good position to respond to surging energy prices
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council Member and President of the Deutsche Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, said on Friday that the central bank is in a good position to respond to surging energy prices.
FX.reason: Another ECB-speak piece that signals readiness to act vs energy-driven inflation — modestly EUR-positive as it implies policy flexibility to counter inflation shocks.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Softens below 1.4100, but bullish outlook stays intact above key support
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair trades in negative territory near 1.4075 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Escalating conflicts in the Middle East boost crude oil prices, supporting the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Commodity-linked CAD gains as oil risk premium rises — directly relevant FX transmission from oil to CAD/USD. Moderate relevance because price action is cited and flows are logical.

FX.title: Indian Rupee rises as RBI intervention suppresses impact of higher oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee gains strongly after a flat opening against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair declines to near 96.50 as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has intervened again to support the Indian Rupee.
FX.reason: Central-bank FX intervention is high-impact for FX flows and risk. RBI intervention supporting INR against USD is a clear, high-relevance USD-flow event.

FX.title: Forex Today: New wave of US tariffs, deepening Middle East conflict keep markets on edge
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Friday, July 24:
FX.reason: Broad FX wrap: tariffs and Middle East escalation are risk/flow drivers that tend to boost USD safe-haven demand and increase volatility. Useful for directional context; moderately high relevance.

FX.title: British Pound remains depressed near 1.3300 despite upbeat UK Retail Sales data
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) remains pinned near three-week lows against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, trading near 1.3300 and on track for a 1% weekly decline.
FX.reason: GBP weakness versus USD despite supportive domestic data signals dominant USD strength / risk-off flows. Relevant to dollar-centric FX basket and GBP positioning.

FX.title: Swiss Franc remains weaker as US Dollar receives support amid US-Iran tensions
FX.summary: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the fifth successive day, trading around 0.8170 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) pares its daily losses amid rising safe-haven demand due to escalating conflicts in the Middl
FX.reason: Safe-haven-driven USD strength vs CHF aligns with broader Middle East tensions and DXY support. Direct FX price action cited; useful confirmation of USD-led regime.

FX.title: Japan’s Katayama Says to Take Bold FX Steps Decisively as Needed
FX.reason: Official hint of possible FX intervention from Japan is high-relevance FX news. Markets interpret such signals as potentially supportive for JPY or at least a constraint on yen weakness; significant for USD/JPY flows.

Commodities.title: Gold: Oil spike caps rebound and keeps risks two-way – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note Gold has retreated back toward USD 4,040/4,050 after briefly trading above 4,160 as Brent surged past USD100 and the Dollar and US yields climbed.
Commodities.reason: Mixed drivers: Middle East-driven oil spike supports safe-haven demand but stronger USD and US yields (Fed hike bets) are bearish for gold. Net tilt slightly negative; relevance medium as this is a cross-influence note rather than a clear price signal.

Commodities.title: Gold bounces off daily low on softer USD; not out of the woods amid Fed rate hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers modest intraday losses amid a modest US Dollar (USD) pullback, though remains below the $4,050 level heading into the European session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Dominant macro (Fed rate-hike bets, stronger USD) weighs on gold despite short-term USD softness. Clear macro transmission to commodity (XAU) price -> medium relevance, modestly negative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains above $57.50 despite rising Fed rate hike odds
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) inches higher after registering over 4% losses in the previous day, trading around $57.60 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Silver showing resilience intraday; underlying macro (rate-hike odds) is a headwind but the metal holding key level is mildly constructive. Price-forecast/technical tone limits relevance.

Commodities.title: Petroleum markets responded to disruptions in the Middle East in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) were characterized by continued disruptions to international crude oil and petroleum product flows through the Strait of Hormuz, contributing to higher and more volatile crude oil prices through most of th
Commodities.reason: Authoritative EIA confirmation that Q2 disruptions (Hormuz, shipping) materially supported higher and more volatile crude prices — strong bullish supply-risk narrative with high relevance to oil market regime.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Small weekly crude build is a modest bearish signal but inventories remain below the five-year average — net neutral-to-slightly supportive for prices; relevance medium for near-term oil supply picture.

Commodities.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices Top $100 as Conflict With Iran Drags On
Commodities.reason: Headline confirmation that Brent > $100 driven by Iran-related conflict — clear market-moving geopolitical supply premium. High relevance for oil prices and risk premia.

Commodities.title: China Rushes to Buy East Russian Oil as Middle East Risks Grow
Commodities.reason: Demand shift into East Russian barrels amid Middle East risks supports overall crude tightness and shows buyers seeking alternate flows — constructive for global oil prices, medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Wheat Extends July Rally as War Risks Stoke Fears Over Supply
Commodities.reason: War/geo-risk driven supply concerns are supporting wheat prices — clear commodity-specific supply shock transmission, medium relevance to agriculture complex.

Commodities.title: China’s Gold Imports Surge After International Prices Slump
Commodities.reason: Rising Chinese physical demand after a price dip is supportive for gold; adds to structural demand narrative even as macro headwinds persist — medium relevance for gold market balance.

Commodities.title: What are tank bottoms?
Commodities.summary: Crude oil inventories held at storage facilities in Cushing, Oklahoma, fell below 20 million barrels during the week ending June 19 until the week ending July 10, according to our Weekly Petroleum Status Report.
Commodities.reason: Context on Cushing draws highlights structural storage tightness that can underpin WTI differentials and market tightness — constructive but more contextual than immediate; lower relevance.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade driven by expanding US export capacity is supportive for gas demand/price structurally; relevant to natural-gas/liquids market supply-demand outlook.

Commodities.title: Brent crude crosses $100 after tankers reportedly struck off Saudi Arabia
Commodities.summary: Oil prices rose after attacks on ships in the Red Sea, and U.S. President Donald Trump's threatened to bomb Iranian infrastructure.
Commodities.reason: Incident-driven tanker strikes and escalation risk pushed Brent > $100 — clear immediate bullish supply-risk impulse with high relevance to oil risk premium.

Commodities.title: Brent: Conflict risks keep prices supported – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent has broken above $100/bbl as Middle East tensions escalate and supply risks mount. They highlight threats to flows through the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, as well as disruptions to Kazakh expo
Commodities.reason: Analyst note reinforcing the conflict-driven supply-support narrative for Brent; supports dominant oil-risk regime — medium-high relevance as it echoes market-moving drivers.

Commodities.title: Oil prices head for weekly rise on Middle East escalation
Commodities.reason: Synthesis of shipping attacks and supply cuts pointing to a weekly oil price rise — reinforces the near-term bullish narrative for crude with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: The oil spike everyone feared never showed up
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal noting that an anticipated extreme oil spike did not materialize — reduces conviction on extreme upside; lower relevance versus dominant conflict-driven supply narrative.

Commodities.title: Indonesia Seeks to Revive Cocoa Output After Years of Decline
Commodities.reason: Policy/industry efforts to revive cocoa output imply potential supply recovery over time, which is a bearish structural signal for cocoa; relevance moderate but longer-term in nature.

Commodities.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.
Commodities.reason: Local price snapshot reflecting intraday moves; low informational content for global commodity trend — slight negative tick only.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Roar Back, Threatening Economy and GOP’s Midterm Hopes
Commodities.reason: Article links rising oil prices to economic and political risks — underscores macro impact of the rally and supports elevated oil risk premium; medium-high relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
Crypto.reason: Macro pressure (rising rates/oil) weighing on Bitcoin price plus a meaningful drop in odds for the Clarity Act increases regulatory uncertainty — net negative for crypto risk assets and flows.

Crypto.title: The SEC settles with Coinbase over its missing Gary Gensler texts
Crypto.reason: Regulatory/legal resolution with the SEC reduces an overhang for a major exchange — modestly positive for market confidence and institutional participation.

Crypto.title: Mirae plans to turn crypto exchange Korbit into something Korea hasn't seen before
Crypto.reason: Large institutional owner building out a regulated exchange platform in Korea supports adoption and liquidity in a key market — positive structural development.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 as $800 billion AI selloff leaves crypto largely untouched
Crypto.reason: Crypto resiliency amid a large tech/AI equity selloff suggests independent demand and risk appetite for BTC — supportive for prices and flows.

Crypto.title: Clarity Act expected to miss its window before Congress' summer break, leadership says
Crypto.reason: Delay to legislative clarity prolongs regulatory uncertainty in the US — a headwind for institutional adoption and ETF/regulatory pass-throughs.

Crypto.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's X account hacked to promote token amid memecoin frenzy
Crypto.reason: High-profile social-account hijack promoting tokens undermines retail trust and highlights ongoing security/operational risks in the ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Tassat wants to help smaller banks tap the trillion-dollar stablecoin boom before Wall Street lock them out
Crypto.reason: Efforts to expand stablecoin access to smaller banks accelerate on‑ramps for fiat-onchain activity — positive for payments/use-case adoption.

Crypto.title: Coinbase's corporate customers can now accept payments from AI agents
Crypto.reason: Product enabling payments from AI agents broadens real‑world crypto payment rails and corporate use-cases — supportive for adoption and onchain volume.

Crypto.title: Uniswap pushes deeper into tokenized assets with permissioned trading pools
Crypto.reason: DEX expansion into tokenized/permissioned pools supports onchain institutionalization and new asset classes — positive structural development.

Crypto.title: BlackRock, Coinbase, Strategy in a new group pledging $15 million to prepare Bitcoin for quantum threats
Crypto.reason: Institutional collaboration to harden Bitcoin against future quantum risk is a credibility/continuity play that supports long‑term institutional confidence.

Crypto.title: Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Capital joins tokenization push as Coinbase takes stake in onchain fund
Crypto.reason: Sovereign/large-capital participation in tokenization funds and Coinbase stake signals material institutional capital and legitimacy for tokenized assets.

Crypto.title: BitMEX, the exchange that invented perps, is shutting down
Crypto.reason: Shutdown of a major derivatives venue removes liquidity and market structure depth for perpetuals — a negative for derivatives markets and risk-taking.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum-linked protocols lose $35 million in multiple attacks hours apart
Crypto.reason: Large, near-simultaneous exploits (~$35m) heighten security concerns and counterparty risk onchain — significant negative for sentiment and onchain trust.
